title: Maxwell status lifecycles
description: Closed status vocabularies. Referenced via $ref to '#/$defs/<name>'. Transitions are documented in the maxwell-conventions skill

vendorStatus.description: Lifecycle of a third-party relationship (company/vendor status)

registrationStatus.description: Standing of a regulatory registration or licence with its regulator (company/details regulatoryRegistrations[].status)

reCategory.description: Regulator's cyber-resilience or supervisory categorisation. mii, qualified-re, mid-size-re, small-size-re and self-certification-re are SEBI CSCRF RE categories; tier-1 to tier-4 are RBI urban co-operative bank regulatory tiers; level-1 to level-4 are RBI UCB cyber-security levels; nbfc-base-layer to nbfc-top-layer are RBI scale-based regulation layers for NBFCs; not-categorised is for regulators that do not tier. Shared by company/details regulatoryRegistrations[].category and catalog/instruments applicability.categories so workflows intersect them by string equality

observationMethod.description: OSCAL observation method: the Maxwell workflow that produced the observation, or 'manual', 'interview', 'document-review' for human collection. The utility entry points (validate, kpis, seed-company, status, connect-sandbox) are not observation methods

observationResult.description: Assessment outcome for the listed controls: satisfied, not-satisfied, partial, not-applicable, or inconclusive when access or evidence was insufficient

riskLikelihood.description: Probability a risk event occurs within a year

riskImpact.description: Consequence if a risk event occurs, on customers, market integrity and the company

priority.description: Scheduling priority set by the change manager: p1 = start immediately (emergency or critical), p2 = next sprint, p3 = this quarter, p4 = backlog. Independent of severity. Shared by change-management initiatives and any finding or risk that carries a scheduling priority

vexJustification.description: OpenVEX machine-readable justification for a not_affected statement

cycloneDxAnalysisState.description: CycloneDX vulnerability analysis.state. Maps to vexStatus as: not_affected/false_positive -> not_affected, exploitable -> affected, resolved/resolved_with_pedigree -> fixed, in_triage -> under_investigation
